literal_meaning: গর্জন বা বিরক্তিকর শব্দের অনুকরণ (onomatopoeic reduplication mimicking grumbling sounds)
figurative_meaning_en: A reduplicative word indicating dissatisfaction or irritation
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চারা খাবার না পেয়ে গজগজ করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The children are muttering complaints because they didn't get food.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in spoken Bengali to denote low-level annoyance.
